mapper.insert: INSERT INTO pets ( owner_id, name, type, breed, weight, age, image_url, deleted_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{ownerId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{breed}, #{weight}, #{age}, #{image}, false, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.select: SELECT p.*, o.name AS owner_name FROM pets p JOIN owners o ON p.owner_id = o.id WHERE p.deleted_at = false ORDER BY p.id DESC
SELECT p.*, o.name AS owner_name FROM pets p LEFT JOIN owners o ON p.owner_id = o.id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted_at = false
Select owner_id Count(*) total from pets group by owner_id where id = ${id}
mapper.update:

owner_id = #{ownerId},
